# Splat design truth

These stills beat conversation memory. Match them; don't re-litigate.

## Locked stills
- `idle-encre.png` — AUTHORITATIVE idle. Soft 5-lobe blot, resting tip, white pill eyes, lime closed smile.
- `laugh-encre.png` — AUTHORITATIVE dark laugh apex. Extended lobes, white `> <`, lime open-D + void.
- `laugh-creme.png` — cream laugh apex (black face). Silhouette follows encre family.

## Motion (Motion taste)
- **Idle orbit:** linear lobe-phase orbit, ~8.5–10s/turn. Face tip stays put (no tumble). State indication.
- **Laugh activate:** strong ease-out, ~320–420ms, ~1.25–1.75 spin turns, then land. Feedback + state. Exit reverses path.
- Mouth opens ONLY on laugh / `world.mouthOpen`.

## Non-goals
- Surface veins/squiggles
- Inventing proportions away from the stills

## How to use
Extract / A/B against these files. Prefer silhouette + face + tip match over parametric guessing.
